caseName: United States v. Safeway Stores, Inc.
caseNameFull: United States v. SAFEWAY STORES, INCORPORATED SAFEWAY STORES, INCORPORATED v. United States
docketNumber: Supreme Court No. 590; Supreme Court No. 591; Court of Claims No. 46976

opinions.text:
Eminent domain; just compensation; amount of compensation due for meat taken during World War Two. Judgment for plaintiff.

Defendant’s petition and plaintiff’s petition for writs of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court June 4, 1951.
